propositions: Grounding finders (G1G2/E4/E6) flag symbols as missing even when a depends_on prerequisite ticket will create them, because they only check the origin/main snapshot and ignore ticket dependencies.
The citation format [rebar:<id>] must be parsed and verified against both upstream dependency directions: P depends_on C or C blocks P.
Layer-1 advisory det_citation must verify citations are edge-backed without ever blocking the verdict (fail-open floor preserved).
Layer-2 LLM coverage protocol must retrieve the cited ticket via show_ticket and confirm its plan/file_impact provides the specific missing functionality before crediting the citation.
A citation that is unparseable, edge-unbacked, or coverage-unconfirmed must fall through to normal grounding rules and produce the original missing-symbol finding.
Reverse-lookup errors (network, store, missing ticket) must be caught and treated as unverified, never propagating exceptions into the advisory lane.
